TextTranslations.Hitting 'Report' will collect session in:
Hitting 'Report' will collect session info into a folder on your computer.

Send the files in the report folder to support@dreadxp.com, or into a new topic in the White Knuckle Bug Reporting Channel in the community discord.

Make sure to include a description of the issue you are having![ST]
TextTranslations.<color=\"yellow\"><size=\"2.3\">BASIC MO:
<color="yellow"><size="2.3">BASIC MOVEMENT</color></size>
{Move} to Move
{Jump} to Jump
{Sprint} to Sprint

Jump over that obstacle to continue![ST]
TextTranslations.<color=\"yellow\"><size=\"2.3\">MANTLING:
<color="yellow"><size="2.3">MANTLING</color></size>
{Hand-Left} and {Hand-Right} readies your hands to grab a climbable surface.

Once grabbed, look at the wall move and towards it ({Move}) to climb up.

Your hands will automatically grab any valid nearby mantleable surface you aim at if you hold your mouse buttons.

Jump and aim at the high ledge above while holding down both hand buttons.
[ST]
TextTranslations.<color=\"yellow\"><size=\"2\">INTRO TO C:
<color="yellow"><size="2">INTRO TO CLIMBING</color></size>
Your {Hand-Left} and {Hand-Right} readies your hands to grab a climbable surface.

Use your movement keys ({Move}) to navigate between climbable surfaces up to the platform above you.

Handholds and other climbing surfaces most often appear <color="red">red</color> like these, but remember that any ledge can be grabbed! [ST]
TextTranslations.This wall is mantleable even from all th:
This wall is mantleable even from all the way down here, give it a try!

Jump and aim for the lip.[ST]
TextTranslations.<color=\"yellow\"><size=\"2.3\">CROUCHIN:
<color="yellow"><size="2.3">CROUCHING</color></size>
You can hold crouch with the crouch button! ({Crouch})
Crouch and walk under this obstruction.[ST]
TextTranslations.<color=\"yellow\"><size=\"2.3\">POINT TO:
<color="yellow"><size="2.3">POINT TO POINT</color></size>
Climbing challenges often require traversing from point to point, handhold to handhold.
Follow the handholds here, and don't forget you can mantle on ledges![ST]
TextTranslations.<color=\"yellow\"><size=\"2.3\">MOMENTUM:
<color="yellow"><size="2.3">MOMENTUM</color></size>
It's important to use <color=red>MOMENTUM</color> to your advantage.

Jump to this hanging pole <color=red>while readying your hands</color> ({Hand-Left} & {Hand-Right})

Once on it, swing back, then swing forwards and release with a jump to fly further.[ST]
TextTranslations.Note how your hands <color=red>auto grab:
Note how your hands <color=red>auto grabbed</color> the pole while readied.
If you ever find yourself falling down, ready your hands and hope you can grab something in time![ST]
TextTranslations.<color=\"yellow\"><size=\"2.3\">STAMINA<:
<color="yellow"><size="2.3">STAMINA</color></size>
Notice that your hands will gradually turn red as you climb.

Holding onto surfaces will drain your stamina and you will lose your grip when your stamina runs out.

Each hand will regain stamina when it's not holding onto a handhold.[ST]
TextTranslations.<color=\"yellow\"><size=\"2.3\">ITEMS &:
<color="yellow"><size="2.3">ITEMS & YOUR INVENTORY</color></size>
You can pick up an item by grabbing it with either hand.

<color=red>Use</color> the item by pressing the hand button holding the item. ({Hand-Left}/{Hand-Right})

<color=red><size=2>Store items in your inventory</size></color> by holding {Inventory} and clicking where you want to place the item.

Opening your inventory and grabbing an item will put it back in your hand.

<color=red>Drop</color> a held item by pressing {Drop-Left} for your left hand and {Drop-Right} for your right hand.
[ST]
TextTranslations.<color=\"yellow\"><size=\"2.3\">CANS OF:
<color="yellow"><size="2.3">CANS OF FOOD</color></size> restore stamina.
Don't forget to toss the empty can after using it.[ST]
TextTranslations.<color=\"yellow\"><size=\"2.3\">PITONS</:
<color="yellow"><size="2.3">PITONS</color></size>
Pitons let you create handholds, though until hammered in fully they are not permanent and secure.

Once placed in a wall, use the hammer to knock it in.

You can place them while climbing, but keep an eye on your stamina.
[ST]
TextTranslations.<color=\"yellow\"><size=\"2.3\">ENCUMBRA:
<color="yellow"><size="2.3">ENCUMBRANCE</color></size>
If you're carrying too many items, your inventory will start turning <color="red">red</color>. Picking up more items while encumbered slows you down for each extra item added.[ST]
TextTranslations.Tip: use your inventory while hanging an:
Tip: use your inventory while hanging and pull out a piton while climbing.

Swap hands when one gets tired, and use the strained hand to hammer in the next piton.

Don't forget to keep hanging![ST]
TextTranslations.<color=\"yellow\"><size=\"2.3\">POCKETS<:
<color="yellow"><size="2.3">POCKETS</color></size>
You have two pockets in your inventory, represented by the circles on each side, that you can store a single item in from each hand.

You can place items in your pocket or pull items from it into your hands by hitting {Pocket-Left} for your left hand, and {Pocket-Right} for your right hand.

You can also place or grab items from your pocket through your inventory screen, like normal!

Be careful, <color="red">large items will not fit in your pockets</color>, and must be grabbed from your inventory manually.
[ST]
TextTranslations.<color=\"yellow\"><size=\"2.3\">HAMMERIN:
<color="yellow"><size="2.3">HAMMERING</color></size>
Your hammer can be used to break certain obstacles or objects. In a pinch, it can also be used as a weapon in the case of self defense.

Break through these boards with your hammer to continue.
[ST]
TextTranslations.<color=\"yellow\"><size=\"2.3\">REBAR</c:
<color="yellow"><size="2.3">REBAR</color></size>
Rebar can be thrown to make a handhold at a distance.

It will ricochet off of surfaces if you throw it at a shallow angle, aim carefully!

Be careful about throwing rebar when you're not on solid ground, you will lose your grip on handholds and be knocked back![ST]
TextTranslations.<color=\"yellow\"><size=2.3>ROPE</color>:
<color="yellow"><size=2.3>ROPE</color></size>
Rope can be swung by holding  {Sprint} and using {Move}.

Jumping off a rope while it is swinging will give you a boost!

Great for crossing big pits![ST]

<color="yellow"><size=2.3>ROPE</color></size>
Rope can be swung using {Move} while looking horizontally. It can be climbed by looking vertically.

Jumping off a rope while it is swinging will give you a boost!

Great for crossing big pits![ST]
TextTranslations.<color=\"yellow\">ACCESS DEV PLAYGROUND<:
<color="yellow">ACCESS DEV PLAYGROUND</color>
It's a cool place!

Warning: You will spoil yourself on content if you haven't made significant progress in the game. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED!
[ST]
